title: FIND THE DIFFERENCE
input_selection_rule: Exactly the SQ-03A preregistered inputs whose predefined peak-voltage anchor rank order differed between MORTY and LILITH.

candidate_edge_rule.description: For each frozen input-anchor pair, candidate edges are matched edges that lie on at least one directed simple path from the input label to the anchor label with hop count <= 4 in the frozen matched graph.

localization_method.name: single-edge counterfactual equalization
localization_method.male_counterfactual: For one candidate edge at a time, replace weight_m with weight_f while leaving every other male edge and all runtime parameters unchanged.
localization_method.female_counterfactual: For one candidate edge at a time, replace weight_f with weight_m while leaving every other female edge and all runtime parameters unchanged.
localization_method.primary_effect_metric: change in the frozen target anchor peak voltage relative to the subject's unmodified SQ-03A baseline

classification_rule.edge_localization: An edge is reportable as a model-level localization candidate if counterfactual equalization changes the corresponding anchor response in either subject. Magnitude is descriptive; no post-hoc significance threshold is introduced.
classification_rule.mechanism_claim: Single-edge sensitivity does not establish a biological mechanism.

prohibited: adding new inputs after localization outputs are seen
adding new anchors after localization outputs are seen
searching multi-edge combinations after seeing single-edge effects
retuning stimulus or runtime parameters by subject
claim_boundary: SQ-03B is a post-hoc mechanistic follow-up to the preregistered SQ-03A comparison. It localizes sensitivity within the frozen matched-central-brain model by counterfactually equalizing one aligned edge weight at a time. It can identify model-level edges associated with the observed SQ-03A response differences, but it does not establish biological mechanism, general sex differences, behavior, intelligence, or financial utility.
